description: This file defines an abstract class PopTextExtraDraw and its subclasses PopOut and PopIn, which handle animated drawing of pop-up text in an Android keyboard view, including animation timing and position calculations.

classes.name: PopTextExtraDraw
classes.description: An abstract class for animated pop-up text drawing with subclasses for pop-in and pop-out animations.

classes.name: PopOut
classes.description: A subclass representing the pop-out animation of text.

classes.name: PopIn
classes.description: A subclass representing the pop-in animation of text.

methods.name: calculateCurrentYPosition
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate the current Y position based on animation progress.

methods.name: calculateAnimationInterpolatorFraction
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate the animation interpolation fraction.
